push.title: L 1-2 vs Flex musix | You: 7.6
push.body:
A 7.6, buddskees. Think of it like a first pancake. Next one's gonna be golden.

THE GOOD
+ 26 passes (up from your usual 14). That's what wanting the ball looks like.
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles. Every tackle you won turned their attack into our counter.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Team-high 3 shots. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.

THE BAD
- Shot accuracy 0%, down from your usual 68%. We'll drill that till it's boring.
- No key passes from 26 passes. Here's a thought: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side. Mind over matter.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 3 and set up a relegation match. That's where we are. It's not where we're staying.
- 0.3 below your norm. Let's turn the page.
- In our wins you average 3 misplaced passes; here it was 6. Real quick: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

This week's homework: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.

buddskees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Nobody remembers the miss. Everybody remembers the response.

Keep chipping away. - Coach Lasso
